title: Read-only ranked candidate frontend test panel

frontend_flag.name: VITE_SHOW_RANKED_CANDIDATE_TEST_PANEL
frontend_flag.purpose: Hide the internal dry-run panel unless explicitly enabled at build time.

placement: ReviewWorkspace, directly below the gated AI Mapping Suggestions and Supervisor advisory area.

dry_run_request.max_candidates_per_row: Capped to the backend capability value.

disabled_behavior: The panel is absent while the frontend flag is false. When visible but backend-disabled, it displays capability metadata and a fail-closed notice without a run control.
result_behavior: Renders capability metadata, safety counters, response summary, rows, and candidates as advisory read-only evidence.
recommended_next_feature: Feature #18F-F - End-to-end dry-run smoke test and UX hardening
